title: The photo Dom Santiago carried through Gears of War
subject: dom
description:
Could you have made Dom's choice? 👇

The story behind Maria Santiago, the woman in Dom's photo, and what he found in Gears of War 2. Spoilers for Gears of War 2.

scenes.text: Dom Santiago carried one photo into every battle for twelve years.
It was a signed picture of his wife, Maria. After their children died, grief pulled her away, and she vanished.
Even in the middle of a war against the Locust, Dom never stopped looking for her.
Then, deep inside a Locust prison camp, he finally found her.
But that's not the worst part. Weeks of torture had left Maria a silent, empty shell.
Dom said goodbye and ended her suffering himself, while Marcus quietly walked away.
